message: OPERATOR ARCHITECTURE CORRECTION (overrides prior C3 escalation premises): 'There are no old clients. I'm the only user. Don't obsess over back compat and migration.' Reassess C3/Work cutover as a single-operator system with no old client fleet; favor simplest safe switchover of current active client(s), preserving actual existing data and unknown-effect safety without speculative backwards-compatibility frameworks or elaborate migration infrastructure. Reprioritize proportionately and trim/remove artificial C3 blockers and overbuilt compatibility plans; coordinate necessary canonical spec changes with workers. This is not independent permission to deploy, alter credentials/rulesets, lose data, or activate live Scheduler/SQLite: explicit cutover GO still separate. The previous request for admin-visibility inventory is not an operator decision needed merely to prove non-existent old clients. Please reflect this in durable canonical task/plan state and proceed.
